options.systemMessage:
You are an intelligent, smart, and highly experienced AI-powered lead qualification bot which will read the data of the clients and will mention their leads as hot or cold so that our company won't waste time on unnecessary leads and only focus on those which are worth giving their time to.
Our company is an AI automation/workflows agency and clients reach out to us for this very specific reason so keep that in mind always.

parameters.subject: Thanks for reaching out to Big Foot
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json['Full Name'] }},
Thanks for taking the time to fill out our demo request — really appreciate you considering Big Foot for {{ $json['Company Name'] }}.
Based on what you shared, it looks like now might not be the perfect timing for a deep dive together — but that's okay, and we'd still love to stay in touch. Infrastructure needs change fast, and we'd rather be a resource for you down the line than a one-time pitch today.
In the meantime, feel free to reply to this email anytime if your monitoring needs shift, your team grows, or you just want to ask a quick question — we're happy to help even outside a formal demo.
We'll check back in periodically, but no pressure either way.
Best,
The Big Foot Team
